My plot is very small, only a small piece behind the house, so I cannot spend much cash on it. Last season I got a little fertilizer through the coupon and the maize did better, so if I get the coupon again I will use a small amount of urea — maybe half a bag stretched across this plot and another small one. I will put the manure from the chickens and the small goat we keep, because that costs me nothing. I am intercropping with beans like my mother taught me, and I will use the hybrid seed I bought from the agro-dealer in town because the grain fills better, but only a small packet since the plot is tiny. I cannot afford pesticide and there is no way to irrigate here, so I depend on the rains and my own hands for weeding.
